bulletins.title: Shelter and heating points
bulletins.body: Nearest shelter locations are listed with your local contact. Carry ID, drinking water, warm clothing and a charged phone.

bulletins.title: Water and power interruptions
bulletins.body: Scheduled interruptions can affect pumping stations and heating. Fill water containers in advance and keep a battery radio ready.

bulletins.title: Retune notice
bulletins.body: If the signal is lost, rescan transponders around 13.0 degrees east before assuming the service has stopped.

bulletins.title: Air raid alert: southern districts
bulletins.body: Follow local civil protection guidance and move to the nearest shelter.

bulletins.title: Rolling power outages 18:00-22:00
bulletins.body: Restoration estimates are published by grid operators; preserve battery power.

bulletins.title: Partial internet degradation and blocked-site additions
bulletins.body: Three newly blocked sites and DNS interference reported.

bulletins.title: Phishing and malware warning
bulletins.body: New phishing campaigns targeting messaging users. Verify links before opening.

bulletins.title: Regional news: emergency repair teams restoring electricity
bulletins.body: Residents are advised to follow verified local instructions.

bulletins.title: Aid points and legal aid reference updated
bulletins.body: New offline guide on aid points, legal aid and evacuation notices.
